snippet.title: Exe tries to save the holidays, a Friendship Test extra story - Trailer
snippet.description:
“Exe tries to save the holidays” is an extra 2h30m/4h30m long story that takes place a few months after the events of Friendship Test. In it you play as Exe, who has accidentally caused a power outage and begins a journey to make everyone happy to make up for her mistake. She is joined by Spike, who doesn’t help much but offers her the emotional support she very much needs.

Meet up with familiar faces to see how their lives are doing after their adventures in FT. Give them gifts, help them with their personal struggles and make sure Exe interacts with the least amount of life forms as possible cause she is not having a good time.

This FT extra story will release in November in itch.io for only $1. It will only release on Windows, but if you are not able to play it or buy it, a full no commentary playthrough will be released in here.
This short story is a love(less) letter for the support the game has received, I was not planning to make it when I released FT, but I just needed to make something now.
It is not as grand story like FT is, but I hope you look forward for a short little story to see these characters one last time (in videogame form at least). Thank you so much and see you there!

---
